native_result.query: In which century did the Diversity in Pottery Form collapses and Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases simultaneuosly?
native_result.HypoA: Around 1800 BCE, Diversity in Pottery Form collapses, while Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases.
native_result.HypoB: Pottery form diversity collapsed while pottery decoration diversity increased simultaneously in the 18th century BCE (1800-1701 BCE, calBP 3750-3650; final Late Neolithic bin, immediately preceding the Older Bronze Age). Across that single 100-year step the Z-value of pottery FORM drops from +0.74 to -1.13 (dZ = -1.87 SD, the largest form decline in the 3800-year record, reaching the lower bound of the observed scale), while the Z-value of pottery DECORATION rises from -0.48 to +0.97 (dZ = +1.45 SD). This opposite-signed combination occurs in exactly 1 of 38 century steps and its mirror image (form up, decoration down) in none, while the two series are otherwise weakly positively correlated (r = +0.11) - so the simultaneity is a unique event, not an anti-correlated trend. Pottery form then remains pinned at the scale floor for the following 1200 years (level shift -1.83 SD), i.e. the change is a permanent reorganisation of formal variability rather than a single-century fluctuation, and it is not preceded or accompanied by any documented decline in the demographic/land-use proxies in these files (Belau pollen openness -0.22 SD, flat site-density KDE).
native_result.WorkflowB: Primary grid = 39 raw 100-yr Z anchors of capital.csv (the sample on which the Z standardisation was performed). Detector: simultaneous successive difference over the same 100-yr step, dZ_form <= -thr*SD and dZ_dec >= +thr*SD, thr in {0.25, 0.5, 0.75}. Replication grids: 37 raw anchors of time_series_data.csv (verified identical to capital.csv, max|diff| = 0), 100-yr bin means of the linear-interpolated yearly series (w = 100/200/300 yr) and the yearly rolling-100 change series (study's pollen_grate_100-style construction). Floor robustness via MAD scaling, rank transform and deletion of the saturated plateau rows. Century assigned by year-overlap of the transition interval plus an anchor-to-bin attachment test using the periodisation labels. Pollen used as context only.
